end.summary:
Practised sorting small numbers as odd or even by pairing; 5 of 6 unaided responses were correct, but the method was not steady and needs checking next time.
Practised using the ones digit to decide odd or even; 1 of 4 unaided responses was correct, so this needs further checking next time.
Jiya used the pairing idea for 7 and described one item left over as odd.
Jiya first said zero was neither odd nor even; this was corrected later, but they continued to judge numbers by any odd digit, including 34 and 70.
end.parentNote: Asha practised odd and even numbers with Jiya by making pairs and noticing whether one item was left over. Jiya gave the pairing explanation for 7, and the zero mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. They still used any odd digit to label a whole number odd, so the ones-digit rule needs more practice next time. At home, sort a few numbers such as 12, 25, 38, and 70 by looking only at the last digit, then check each with pairs.
